resolved_intents.intent: Get tell your experience text value

missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should retrieve the current text from the feedback text field using get_entered_text() and verify that the text length does not exceed the expected maximum character limit. It should also verify the character count display matches the actual text length. The method should raise an assertion error if the text exceeds the maximum length or if the character count is incorrect. The method should return True if validation passes.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'edit_feedback' element to be present using self.driver.wait_for_object('edit_feedback')
Call existing get_entered_text() method to retrieve current text value from the feedback text field
Calculate the actual character count of the retrieved text using len()
Assert that the actual character count does not exceed expected_max_length parameter
Wait for 'edit_feedback_char_count' element to be present using self.driver.wait_for_object('edit_feedback_char_count')
Call existing get_feedback_text_char_count() method to retrieve the character count display text
Parse the character count display text to extract the current count value (format expected: 'X/Y' where X is current count)
Assert that the parsed current count from the display matches the actual character count calculated from the text
Assert that the parsed current count does not exceed expected_max_length
Return True if all validations pass
Raise AssertionError with descriptive message if text length exceeds maximum or character count display is incorrect
